entries.text: Excuse me, brother. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?
entries.source_text: Excuse me, brother. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?

entries.text: What are you doing?
entries.source_text: What are you doing?

entries.text: 你是做什么的？

entries.text: Ah, yes, a super mutant in training. I will return to my tasks.
entries.source_text: Ah, yes, a super mutant in training. I will return to my tasks.

entries.source_text: 一个超级变种人正在受训，我要回到自己的岗位。

entries.text: If you do not know, it is none of your concern. If you are inquiring# about something you should not know, then I will have to report you to our# supervisors. You should know better.

entries.source_text: I am a person of high importance.

entries.source_text: 我是一个很重要的人物。

Who the hell are you to be asking me questions?! You're lucky I don't
# report you to the holy flame!!

entries.source_text: Transferring the reports, of course.

entries.source_text: 当然，我要递送报告。

entries.text: Reports of what? If I make ask.

entries.source_text: 报告什么？我可以问问吗？

entries.text: And a mighty fine job you're doing.
entries.source_text: And a mighty fine job you're doing.

entries.text: 你的工作干得不错。
entries.source_text: 你的工作干得不错。

entries.text: That is all. Thank you.
entries.source_text: That is all. Thank you.

entries.text: 没事，多谢。
entries.source_text: 没事，多谢。

entries.text: Very well, then. Peace be with you.
entries.source_text: Very well, then. Peace be with you.

entries.text: 很好，祝你平安。
entries.source_text: 很好，祝你平安。

entries.text: I apologize. How may I be of service?
entries.source_text: I apologize. How may I be of service?

entries.source_text: 卫兵！！！

entries.source_text: It is obvious you do not belong here. Who are you?

entries.source_text: 你显然不属于这里，你是谁？

entries.source_text: I am actually a Vault Dweller and would like to speak to the Master.

entries.source_text: 我是避难所的居民，我要和主教谈话。

entries.source_text: 多非斯……不对，……是墨菲斯让我来的。

entries.source_text: I am Loki. An initiate from the south.

entries.source_text: 我是洛基，从南方来的新学员。

entries.source_text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.

entries.source_text: 我是墨菲斯派来给主教送信的。

entries.source_text: It is none of your business who I am... just answer my questions!

entries.source_text: 我是谁不管你的事……回答我的问题！

You dare question who I am? Fool, I should strike you down where you

entries.text: That's rather odd... I've never heard of you.
entries.source_text: That's rather odd... I've never heard of you.

entries.source_text: 奇怪啊……我怎么从来没听说过你。

entries.text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.
entries.source_text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.

entries.text: 我是墨菲斯派来给主教送信的。
entries.source_text: 我是墨菲斯派来给主教送信的。

# Master the final news of a possible Lost Vault. It may still have pure-strain
# humans in it.

entries.text: 嗯？当然。我向主教带来最新的未受辐射的纯种人类的消息。我向主教汇报有关消失避难所的搜寻的最新进展。那里可能有纯种人类存在。
entries.source_text: 嗯？当然。我向主教带来最新的未受辐射的纯种人类的消息。我向主教汇报有关消失避难所的搜寻的最新进展。那里可能有纯种人类存在。

entries.text: Yes, my brother. You do understand. Thank you. That is all.
entries.source_text: Yes, my brother. You do understand. Thank you. That is all.

entries.text: 好，看来你是明白的，就这样了。
entries.source_text: 好，看来你是明白的，就这样了。

entries.text: I would like to ask you a few other questions.
entries.source_text: I would like to ask you a few other questions.

entries.text: 我还要问你一些问题。
entries.source_text: 我还要问你一些问题。

entries.text: You wouldn't know a pure-strain human if he was standing right in# front of you. Idiot.
entries.source_text:
You wouldn't know a pure-strain human if he was standing right in
# front of you. Idiot.

entries.text: 你不知道站在你面前的就是一个纯种的人类，白痴！
entries.source_text: 你不知道站在你面前的就是一个纯种的人类，白痴！

entries.text: You wouldn't know a pure-strain human if she was standing right in# front of you. Idiot.

entries.text: You act very strangely. I do not believe that you are who you say you# are. Guards!

entries.text: 你的表现很奇怪，我不相信你了，卫兵！！！

entries.text: 你问的太多了，我不相信你了，卫兵！！！
entries.source_text: 你问的太多了，我不相信你了，卫兵！！！

entries.text: Hey! I told you were not allowed down here! Guards!
entries.source_text: Hey! I told you were not allowed down here! Guards!

entries.text: 嘿！我说过了你不能在这里！卫兵！
entries.source_text: 嘿！我说过了你不能在这里！卫兵！

entries.text: You ask too many questions. Who are you?
entries.source_text: You ask too many questions. Who are you?

entries.text: 你问的太多了，你是谁？
entries.source_text: 你问的太多了，你是谁？

entries.text: Excuse me, sister. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?
entries.source_text: Excuse me, sister. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?

entries.text: 对不起，教友，你吓着我了。你有什么要我帮忙的？
